tldr: Two live MSP-tooling exploitation campaigns (ConnectWise ScreenConnect/SCKit, N-able N-central) are driving crypto-mining and remote-access abuse on unpatched systems. Optimizely and Barracuda both disclosed breaches hitting high-profile customers (CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce sites), and Uber disclosed a vendor breach affecting ~150,000 people. Google's threat intel team confirmed attackers are now using AI agents to auto-generate exploits straight from vendor patches.

emerging.title: AI agents now auto-generate exploits from vendor patches
emerging.description: Google's Threat Intelligence Group found attackers using LLM-driven agentic frameworks to diff patched vs. unpatched code and produce working exploits automatically, demonstrated against PaperCut NG/MF — sharply compressing patch-to-exploit timelines. (Nov 16, 2026)

emerging.title: QUIC and Covert: HTTP/3-tunneled RATs hit SE Asian governments
emerging.description: Unit 42 identified a cyberespionage campaign deploying the PerfectPioneer RAT and modular KUKURAT malware, with C2 traffic tunneled over HTTP/3/QUIC — a channel that slips past traditional TLS-based network inspection. (Nov 16, 2026)

items.title: ConnectWise: ScreenConnect/SCKit attacks continue on unpatched systems
items.description: ConnectWise confirms the worm-like SCKit campaign is still spreading on on-prem ScreenConnect servers running outdated software with vulnerable third-party extensions enabled; Huntress logged another spike (205 hosts/41 orgs) Nov 13. Update to 26.6.5+ and disable flagged extensions.

items.title: N-able patches 17 N-central flaws as attackers deploy crypto miners via older bugs
items.description: N-able shipped N-central 2026.4 Hotfix 3 fixing 17 CVEs (auth bypass, XXE, RCE path traversal), while attackers actively exploit the earlier "4EverAble2Shell" bugs — present when legacy API mode is enabled — to install cryptominers on unpatched servers.

items.title: UnrealIRCd flaw (CVE-2026-114713) exploited in the wild
items.description: A high-severity flaw letting attackers run commands with server/IRCOp privileges is being actively exploited; CISA added it to the KEV catalog Nov 13. Patch immediately if running UnrealIRCd.

items.title: Unpatched Danfoss refrigeration controller flaws actively scanned
items.description: Six unauthenticated RCE flaws in Danfoss AK-SM800A controllers have no fix even in the newest firmware; SANS ISC reports active scanning for them, following real-world attacks on French/European supermarket refrigeration systems since October.

items.title: Optimizely supply-chain attack hits CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce sites
items.description: A compromise of the Optimizely CMS/experimentation platform delivered malware through embedded widgets on major media and enterprise websites, exposing site visitors via a trusted third-party script.

items.title: Barracuda confirms breach tied to AI-powered ARTEX attack tool
items.description: Barracuda linked a cloud breach to the agentic "ARTEX" offensive framework now being adopted by Chinese threat actors to speed up intrusions — days after the FBI warned ARTEX is powering attacks globally.

items.title: Uber discloses third-party vendor breach, ~150,000 affected
items.description: Uber says attackers used compromised credentials at an AI/infrastructure vendor (reported as Fireworks AI) to access driver's license data; notifications began Nov 10 and the impacted count is still growing via state filings.

items.title: BO Team exploits Log4Shell to reach Russian firm's code-signing server
items.description: Kaspersky details a months-long BO Team (Black Owl) intrusion that exploited Log4Shell against an unpatched VMware vCenter 7.0.3 server to reach the hypervisor and ultimately compromise a Russian software developer's code-signing infrastructure.

items.title: EU sanctions pro-Russia hackers and Doppelganger disinformation staff
items.description: The EU imposed sanctions on two dozen individuals tied to a Kremlin-linked disinformation contractor and pro-Russia hacking activity, continuing pressure on Russian influence and cyber operations ahead of winter.

items.title: Microsoft rules out cyberattack in outage, warns of related phishing
items.description: Microsoft confirmed a recent service outage wasn't attack-related but flagged a phishing campaign impersonating Microsoft 365 service notices that references the real outage and threatens to delete held messages.

action: Patch/mitigate now if exposed: ConnectWise ScreenConnect (update to 26.6.5+, disable flagged third-party extensions), N-able N-central (apply Hotfix 3, disable legacy API mode), and UnrealIRCd (CVE-2026-114713) — all three are under active exploitation. Danfoss AK-SM800A controllers have no patch; isolate from the network if deployed. Review any Optimizely or Barracuda exposure in your stack.
